answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and, for each epoch, proves membership while evaluating an RLN polynomial that binds its signal to a rate-limit nullifier. Exceeding the quota with distinct signals exposes two Shamir shares; anyone can interpolate the private key, verify it against the commitment, and trigger immediate collateral slashing. Epoch binding prevents stale proofs from enabling fresh violations; nebula and tundra deployments use the same check.
